buyer: Gurnet Point Capital, LLC and Patient Square Capital

premium.basis: 45% premium to the 30-day VWAP as stated in the board rationale

value_inflection_events.event: Failure of abaloparatide transdermal patch Phase III wearABLe trial announced
Positive Phase 3 topline results for TYMLOS in male osteoporosis and elacestrant EMERALD trial

leaked_early.details: No public leak of the specific buyer/price more than 1 month before announcement; activist pressure and strategic review were public but the deal itself was not reported until the official announcement on 2022-06-23.

notes: The deal followed a failed Phase III trial that wiped out over half the market cap; the board ran a targeted process contacting 15 parties, but only one whole-company bidder emerged, resulting in a heavily negotiated cash+CVR structure.
